goal: Add a deterministic one-way Cloud Asset KNOWLEDGE to Obsidian mirror adapter and verify live canonical records by local Vault read-back.
instructions: Use the read-only Cloud Asset Read connector as the canonical source.
Only write derived Markdown notes under the local Vault's Cloudflare Canonical Mirror directory.
Do not write Cloudflare Canonical, restore PersonOS or Knowledge Curator, add Inbox behavior, or create bidirectional sync.
Keep code, focused tests, operator documentation, and this complete expected_files list within the task scope.
acceptance: The renderer is deterministic and the writer is idempotent by asset ID, version, and content hash.
A new canonical version updates the same note path.
Unmanaged notes and unsafe asset IDs are not overwritten.
Three production Cloud Asset KNOWLEDGE records are written to a real Obsidian Vault and independently read back with matching asset ID, versions, hash, and canonical content.
The standard future chain is Candidate review and conflict checks, Cloudflare Canonical write/read-back, then one-way Obsidian mirror sync/read-back.
